calls.reason: The 2022 STRIVE paper supports edge cases as a central challenge, but Waymo's blog describes a dedicated rare-scenario test team in 2015, undercutting 'only in the last few years'. The evidence is mixed.

In the household-helper context, the 2022 Stretch paper shows a research platform with partly teleoperated chores, Astro's launch lists no chores, and Google's robotics head said robots were mostly narrow industrial machines.

The only pre-post links between Transformers or LLMs and formal methods were narrow robustness certificates and autoformalization of math. Neither verifies model behaviour at anything like the assurance level of chip or aircraft verification.
